modify: path:        path of the JSON to be updated.
subsystem:   subsystem for which API behavior needs to be modified.
api:         api for which a particular attribute has to be updated.

cardInfo: isNtnProfileActive: valid isNtnProfileActive are 0 - not active and 1 - active only.
simRefresh: fileId:    Elementary file id in SIM.
aid:       AID (Application Identifier) applicable for NONPROVISIONING session type.

memoryfull: storageType:  valid storage types are NONE , SIM

profileListRequest: referenceId:      valid reference id for profile list request, positive integer greater than zero
profileOperationRequest: referenceId:      valid reference id for profile operation request, positive integer greater than zero
isEnable:         valid profile operation are 0 & 1 only. 0-Disable, 1-Enable

step1: If any profile is active, disable it before enabling other profile, since single profile can be active at a time, MEP FR is yet to come (example: telsdk_event_injector -f tel_apsimprofile -e profileOperationRequest 1 512 89010020000011293999 0) step2: Execute subscription info changed after profile disablement (example: telsdk_event_injector -f tel_sub -e subscriptionInfoChanged 1 '' '' '' '' '' '' '' '' '') step3: Enable new profile(example: telsdk_event_injector -f tel_apsimprofile -e profileOperationRequest 1 512 89010020000011294999 1) step4: Execute subscription info changed for profile enablement (example: telsdk_event_injector -f tel_sub -e subscriptionInfoChanged 1 carrier-1 1234567890 89010020000011294999 310 01 310012345566677 ffffffffffffffff ffffffffffffffff)

signalStrengthUpdate: slotId:           integer, valid slotIds are 1 & 2 only.
Note: Signal Strength is separated by comma and each RAT signal info is represented as below
rat:     string, RAT type. RAT for retrieving Signal Strength information. valid values are GSM, LTE, WCDMA, NR5G, NB1_NTN.
In case of RAT is GSM,   integer, p1->gsmSignalStrength, p2->gsmBitErrorRate, p3->gsmRssi.
In case of RAT is LTE,   integer, p1->lteSignalStrength, p2->lteRsrp, p3->lteRsrq, p4->lteRssnr, p5->lteCqi, p6->timingAdvance, p7->lteRssi.
In case of RAT is WCDMA, integer, p1->signalstrength, p2-> bitErrorRate, p3->ecio, p4->rscp, p5->rssi.
In case of RAT is NR5G,  integer, p1->rsrp, p2->rsrq, p3->rssnr.
In case of RAT is NB1_NTN,  integer, p1->signalStrength, p2->rsrp, p3->rsrq, p4->rssnr, p5->rssi.

load: telsdk_event_injector -f calc -e load sm2 <load> nist256 <load> nist384 <load> bp256 <load> bp384 <load>
load: integer, curve-wise absolute load. For example, a value of 1000 for sm2 means, 1000 sm2 type verification were completed.
Example: telsdk_event_injector -f calc -e load sm2 12 nist256 5 nist384 9 bp256 7 bp384 21
capacity: telsdk_event_injector -f calc -e capacity sm2 <capacity> nist256 <capacity> nist384 <capacity> bp256 <capacity> bp384 <capacity>
capacity: integer, curve-wise absolute capacity. For example, a value of 1000 for sm2 means, 1000 sm2 type verification can be completed.
Example: telsdk_event_injector -f calc -e capacity sm2 4000 nist256 4000 nist384 2200 bp256 4000 bp384 1500

ssr: serviceStatus: valid service status are SERVICE_AVAILABLE, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE & SERVICE_FAILED.
sec_report: telsdk_event_injector -f ccs -e sec_report threat_score <score> cell_id <cid> pid <pid> mcc <mcc> mnc <mnc> threats <threats> action_type <action> rat <rat> env_state <state>
score: Integer. Represents the threat score, ranging from 0 to 500.
cid: Integer. Unique identifier of a cell operated by a mobile network operator.
pid: Integer. Physical cell ID.
mcc: Integer. Mobile Country Code.
mnc: Integer. Mobile Network Code.
threats: Integer. Bitmask of threat types as defined in telux::sec::CellularThreatType.
action: Integer. Value corresponding to an enumerator from telux::sec::ActionType.
rat: Integer. Value corresponding to an enumerator from telux::sec::RATType.
state: Integer. Value corresponding to an enumerator from telux::sec::EnvironmentState.
Example: telsdk_event_injector -f ccs -e sec_report threat_score 250 cell_id 3 pid 1 mcc 311 mnc 030 threats 12 action_type 0 rat 4 env_state 2

ssr: serviceStatus: valid service status are SERVICE_AVAILABLE, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE & SERVICE_FAILED.
sec_report: telsdk_event_injector -f wcs -e sec_report ssid <wifiname> bssid <bssid> is_connected <coninfo> is_open <openinfo> ml_algo_analysis_threat_score <score> ml_analysis_result <ml_result> summoning_analysis_result <summoning_result>
wifiname: Name of the WiFi network (service set identifier).
bssid: MAC address of the AP.
coninfo: true if the device is connected to this AP otherwise false.
openinfo: true if devices can connect to this AP without authentication otherwise false.
score: An integer representing threat score determined by ML algorithm from 0 to 100.
ml_result: An integer representing an enumerator from telux::sec::AnalysisResult.
summoning_result: An integer representing an enumerator from telux::sec::AnalysisResult.

Example: telsdk_event_injector -f wcs -e sec_report ssid wifiname bssid 02:13:37:a9:50:09 is_connected false is_open true ml_algo_analysis_threat_score 100 ml_analysis_result 3 summoning_analysis_result 2
deauth_attack: telsdk_event_injector -f wcs -e deauth_attack deauth_reason <reason> ap_init_disconnect <info> score <score>
reason: An integer representing reason code why disassociation or deauthentication occurred.
info: true if the AP initiated the disconnection otherwise false.
score: An integer representing threat score from 0 to 100.
Example: telsdk_event_injector -f wcs -e deauth_attack deauth_reason 7 ap_init_disconnect true score 25
is_trusted_ap: wifiname: Name of the WiFi network (service set identifier).
bssid: MAC address of the AP.
Example: telsdk_event_injector -f wcs -e is_trusted_ap ssid wifiname bssid 02:13:37:a9:50:09

ssr: serviceStatus: valid service status are SERVICE_AVAILABLE, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE & SERVICE_FAILED.
